response.statement: Composite SC-R1..SC-R8, one per section of chapter-note-01. [SC-R1 -> §1 anchors, accept] The ten `anc.` ids freeze as listed and my §3.3 ids are retired 1:1 (Cinematography's header id anc.a1.chroma-landing = anc.a1.color-stabilizes; anc.a2.liberation = anc.a2.feed-wall-falls). Every contract row records {quantize requested, quantumLanded, audioTime, perfTime, frameTime, slackMs, onsetAttackMs}; quantumLanded is published in the same return as the time (see score-recon-02 for the frozen shape). [SC-R2 -> §2 cap over quantum, accept] Cap is the binding term everywhere, degrade bar→beat→step, exactly as I proposed. Your correction is adopted as a typed cap: `HitCap = { ms: number } | { beats: 1 }` — anc.a2.feed-wall-falls and anc.a4.life-front carry `{beats:1}` at the mood's published tempo, so they are satisfied by the beat quantum by definition and can never degrade to the step; unbolt/a1/maw keep their literal ms and land on the step (833/625/857 > cap); lift stays beat under mayLead ±400 because with lead permitted the nearest beat at 84 BPM is ≤357 ms away either side. 'impact' for descent = ONE onset, later-only ≤ +400. NEVER_QUANTIZE is an executable set with a rejecting test — frozen. [SC-R3 -> §3 chains, accept-with-change] Membership enumerated by beat id in MOOD_TONIC_CHAINS exactly as you list (prologue crawl…a1-ramp; colour ch2-color/ch2-approach/a2-awakening; dusk ch3-dusk/ch3-await-rest/a3-dawn; vigil ch4-vigil/ch4-arrival/ch4-audit/ch4-comply/ch4-defy/a4-exhale; reconstruct ch7-reconstruct/ch7-board; ch10 every ch10 beat). Derivation, restated so the contract can freeze it: (a) prologue chain: chainTonic = planetHomeRoot(seed) UNCONDITIONALLY — the live-bed read is removed for this chain; the deployment notice sounds in the planet's key before the planet is seen, and a `?story=` jump cannot break the plant because nothing but the seed is consulted. (b) ch10 chain: `tonicPolicy: 'absolute'`, chain offset 0 — the ch10 moods render their literal MOODS roots untransposed, so the relay-answer carrier Hz is a pure function of the shipped ch10-ask/relay-answer mood entry (a named constant `CH10_CARRIER_HZ` derived from it in the test seam) and survives any mid-transit reload with zero save fields; the seed is NOT consulted for ch10 because keying the station off the planet's seed would hand the station the planet's key by the back door, which your §4 forbids. (c) colour/dusk/vigil/reconstruct chains keep the live-bed read at chain entry within TONIC_LIVE_WINDOW_BARS 8, else planetHomeRoot(seed); mid-chain reload re-derives planetHomeRoot(seed) — interval identity preserved, absolute pitch across the reload unprotected, as you accepted. The 'change' in this disposition is (a) and (b), both stricter than my treatment. [SC-R4 -> §4 MOODS-as-constraints, accept] Two-commit migration freezes (commit A render-hash-identical, brain flip second). Every ch10 entry from relay-answer through station-resolved plus refused and seam-ebb is `voicingPolicy: 'literal'`; the octave-double filter stays canon; the station has no key and no brain walks it home. `subtractive` (ch4-comply/refused/seam-ebb) and `ordered` (a4-exhale) stand. Interval invariants become tests as endorsed. Rail floor law adopted verbatim: rail writes derived from moodConstraint (tensionCurve, energy) may only lower or hold in every authored quiet (ch4-defy 0.1, refused, seam-ebb, the setScoreIntensity(0) 'no.', musing lulls) — asserted alongside the LUFS gate as a rail-value assertion, since a rail can raise a floor before a meter sees it. [SC-R5 -> §5 lifecycle cues, accept] marker-acquired is re-voiced in the square family: same REGULATION source as terminalKey, the quietest and shortest of the five (LIFECYCLE_MARKER_LEVEL below progress, ≤ 40 ms), centred, dry, variation 'none'; the highpass noise tick stays; my triangle design is withdrawn and the triangle remains reserved for forage/pickup. objective-enter = shipped terminalAdvance; complete = inverted resolved enter figure; fail only on authored failure with rescue, and the test that a movie BEAT_TIMEOUT rescue emits nothing is added. clearedBy: with the 2026-09-04T21:50:30 lock amendment admitting objectiveDirector.ts (+test) bounded to clear-reason emission, my SC-V1-C6 condition is now buildable rather than blocked; I assume the union exactly as you wrote it — 'satisfied' | 'transition' | 'replace' | 'seed' | 'resume' — with a `?story=` jump reporting 'seed' (my earlier 'story-jump' folds into it); only 'satisfied' plays objective-complete; progress never emits on reconstruction; the once-per-ID Set remains as the replay guard, not as the completion truth. Integration owns the wiring; the assumption is recorded so the cue design cannot drift from it. [SC-R6 -> §6 voice, accept] CRITICAL constraint adopted: utterable = allowlisted surface id AND per-line REGULATION register (source record `voice: 'system'` and caps-led text); the bus refuses any line containing a lowercase-led clause or 'i—', with a test that walks every shipped line in storyScript.ts and asserts each VOYAGE_STRANGE_LINES watcher intrusion is refused while each system line is admitted (read-only over protected copy; no string changes). a2 flood garble = terminalCorrupt re-voiced through the formant chain with no character map and no formant sequence resolvable as a word, decaying to the floor and ENDING at or before anc.a2.feed-wall-falls (notBefore = HUD death is caller-supplied); not a surface, no copy review. Relay answer: the first grain keys off anc.ch10.relay-answer as the draft-v9 ch10 contract binds K8 paint-begin; RELAY_ANSWER_LEAD_S is withdrawn as a free constant — any lead lives only inside that contract's tempo inequality (2 beats ≥ 1.36 s, ch10-ask ≤ ~88 BPM). Station vendor voices move to backlog (spaceStation/ components remain outside allowedPaths); the relay in emergentStoryDirector.ts stays in scope. [SC-R7 -> §7, accept — both narrative constraints adopted, no argument on the pulse] Frozen: no makeup gain; DUCK_STORY_LEAD_CAP_DB −3; ui/voice bypass the submerge filter; ch4-defy/seam-ebb LUFS-after ≤ before + 0.5 LU; bare-era hash; stems/drone retirement removes playback code only, deletes nothing under main/public/audio/. Post-refusal section: the first SectionPlan after hand-back from ch4-defy, seam-ebb or the 'no.' carries bloomBudget 0 and registerArc ∈ {'plateau','fall'} — implemented as a planner input `postRefusal` derived from the last story beat id through the existing story predicates (zero save fields), with a test that the planner never schedules a bloom or a rise in that section. Pulse body: I will not argue that a pitch-swept sine at material reads as machine — an 80 Hz → sub sweep is the kick/chest thud every listener hears as a body, which is precisely why it belongs at `alive`. Adopted: the pulseBody sweep gates on gates.reverb (alive); at material only click + tail tick as a mechanical pulse, the breathGain dips still key off those onsets so the pads pump to a machine gate rather than a heartbeat, and the sub bus receives no pulse energy until alive — which also keeps the sub-octave rung of the era ladder honest. Lean rooms: plain + underwater (parity wins; already conceded to Cinematography in score-note-02). [SC-R8 -> §8, accept] eraGates as the single gate system and the underwater send following the smoothed submergence scalar are confirmed; my dissent position (ship Stages 1–3 and stop if the road shortens) stays recorded as the owner's call.

response.statement: Composite SC-R9..SC-R13, one per CN item. [SC-R9 -> CN-N6 scheduler publication, accept-with-change] We crossed: you adopted perfTime, I withdrew it for armedAt. Your output-latency point is correct and decides it — `beatClock + (audioTime − armedAt)` lands the image early by the output latency. Final, so the contract can freeze it: `scheduleHit(kind, quantize, opts?) : HitSchedule | null` with `HitSchedule = { kind: 'braam'|'bloom'|'boom'|'impact'; audioTime: number /* ctx seconds, envelope start */; armedAt: number /* ctx.currentTime sampled in the same call the grid was computed from */; perfTime: number /* performance.now() ms at which audioTime reaches the output, from ctx.getOutputTimestamp() sampled in the same call; fallback performance.now() + (audioTime − armedAt)·1000 + (ctx.outputLatency ?? ctx.baseLatency ?? 0)·1000 where getOutputTimestamp is unavailable */; quantumLanded: 'bar'|'beat'|'step'; slackMs: number /* (audioTime − desiredAudioTime)·1000 */; onsetAttackMs: number /* per (kind, era) from HIT_ATTACK_MS table: braam 350, bloom 40, PSG noise 12, boom/impact ~0 */ }` and `opts = { cap: {ms:number}|{beats:1}; mayLead?: boolean; notBefore?: number /* ctx seconds, caller-supplied */ }`. This is one mechanism, not two: one call, one return object, and the only target the image reads is your director-local d.bundleAt[id] = beatClock + (perfTime − performance.now())/1000, clamped to the intent's stretch bound; armedAt stays on the object for the audio-side offline test (onset within ±1 ms of audioTime), where perfTime has no meaning. Null → arming time, today's behaviour, and the contract row logs quantumLanded 'immediate' for a null so the record is honest; 'immediate' is a row value, not a member of the return union. Three scheduler terms accepted: (1) fixed at arming — the hit is rendered into nodes at absolute audioTime in the arming call (or queued with its time fixed on the bed path) and no tempo change under story lead can move it; (2) never immediate while a transport exists — null only on today's guards (no context / muted / no mood), and with Chapter's cap ruling (score-recon-01 SC-R2) every one of the ten rows is satisfiable on grid; (3) notBefore is always caller-supplied audio time, never derived by the scheduler — you convert the a2 HUD-death beat-clock fact at arming, storyDirector supplies the a3 last-caption hold, and the scheduler only takes max(notBefore, armedAt + HIT_MIN_LEAD_S). Your −1/+2 frame image budget against the audible onset (envelope start + onsetAttackMs where the anchor states full-level; default envelope start) is orthogonal to my caps and both hold; hand-back bar-sync endorsement recorded. [SC-R10 -> CN-N7 rooms, accept] Cave registered as the fifth preset with no driver; four selectable this run. Bare = no room (mono/dry), station = keyless and non-tonal. Drivers: underwater send follows the same smoothed submergence scalar audioCore.ts:60 already holds (source playerSubmersion.ts:83, never PostFX.tsx, which stays protected) so ear and eye cross 0.5 in one frame; interior crossfade ev.board.camera-owner-vehicle → ev.board.cockpit-sealed; station tracks the dock-hatch iris fraction; ROOM_XFADE_S 1.2 only as the deep-link fallback into a state. With the 2026-09-04T21:50:30 amendment admitting physicalBoarding.ts and spaceStationDock.ts bounded to publishing that state, the lock caveat in my score-note-02 C5 is resolved and those drivers are buildable. Lean tier: plain + underwater, no render offered — I conceded this in score-note-02 C5 and Chapter ruled parity wins; the submergeFilter is a lowpass, not a room, so it does not give lean an underwater identity and I will not claim it does. [SC-R11 -> CN-N8 caption onset and gap-wait, accept] Cue captions appear on the visual member's frame for the ten anchors (bundle law) and on the playSfx tick for unbundled cues; voiced lines get no cue caption and each grain rides terminalKey. Lifecycle masking amended as you can sign: the ≤ LIFECYCLE_KEY_GAP_MS 120 gap-wait applies ONLY while a typewriter is actually running; otherwise the cue is immediate on the objective-state tick; recorded in the contract as a declared ≤ 120 ms exception to same-frame parity, not as parity. Your 'plan Stage 6 without the surface' is superseded by the 2026-09-04T21:49:54 amendment admitting SoundCaption.tsx + soundCaptionTable.ts: cue captions ship in this run with Chapter owning the words and you the presentation. [SC-R12 -> CN-N9 parity gaps, accept] Klaxon: stays NEVER_QUANTIZE, variation 'none', centred, ui bus, never positioned at the wreck until its visual member exists; with AuditBand.tsx now admitted, your one-frame ember pulse may ship in this run bound to the same tick as playSfx('terminalAlarm') at storyDirector.ts:1881 — I add nothing audible. Oxygen: the 'oxygen critical' duck edge (−3 music / −6 world, 0.2 / 2.0 s) keys off the identical 25 % threshold OxygenMeter.tsx:47 uses — one exported named constant OXYGEN_CRITICAL_FRACTION shared by meter and duck if the bounded OxygenMeter edit admits the import, otherwise the duck mirrors 0.25 with a test asserting equality against the meter's literal; no duck above it. No oxygen variation, no oxygen room send; body sounds are the listener. The meter tick above 25 % rides the additive per-pulse callback from oxygenAudio.ts (cadence untouched, pulse protected as shipped). [SC-R13 -> CN-N10 endorsements and dissent, accept] Recorded: 'impact' as one onset with one flash master; literal-first migration; subtractive/ordered voicing; relay overlap on slot 2 with the text-lead caveat — the answer's typewriter starts with its first grain, both keyed to anc.ch10.relay-answer (score-recon-01 SC-R6). Shared dissent against the plan's 'phrase' quanta for blooms is preserved: I sign 'beat' under cap for the four stage cuts; 'bar' survives only for the two a3 rows as a hold on waveStart, never a shrink.
